fusions.name: Last Morsel
fusions.desc: Snatches a piece from the first enemy in its path for 22 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Clear the Table
fusions.desc: Sweeps an arm across everything in reach, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Family Style
fusions.desc: Lays a spread where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Room for Seconds
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
